en.headline: Eco Expo Asia 2026 opens at AsiaWorld-Expo with new ASEAN Pavilion
en.dek: The four-day trade fair, co-organised by the HKTDC and the Environment and Ecology Bureau, runs until 29 October under the theme Connecting the World for a Sustainable Future.
body: Eco Expo Asia 2026 opened on Monday at AsiaWorld-Expo, bringing together more than 340 exhibitors from 15 countries and regions under the theme Connecting the World for a Sustainable Future.

Jointly organised by the Hong Kong Trade Development Council and Messe Frankfurt (HK) Ltd and co-organised by the Environment and Ecology Bureau, the event runs until Thursday. A new ASEAN Pavilion features green technology companies from seven member countries, including first-time participants from Indonesia, Laos, the Philippines, Thailand and Vietnam.
Exhibits cover green energy, frontier technology, greener cities and waste-to-worth solutions. The final day, 29 October, is a public day with free admission.
More than 30 forums and seminars are scheduled, with officials and industry representatives from the mainland, ASEAN and Belt and Road countries expected to attend.

zh.headline: 國際環保博覽2026今起亞洲國際博覽館開幕 設東盟展館
zh.dek: 由貿發局與環境及生態局合辦的四日展會以「連接世界 共建可持續未來」為主題，展期至29日，最後一日設公眾日免費入場。
body: 國際環保博覽2026周一在亞洲國際博覽館開幕，吸引超過340家來自15個國家及地區的展商參與，主題為「連接世界 共建可持續未來」。
展覽由香港貿易發展局與法蘭克福展覽（香港）有限公司合辦，環境及生態局協辦，展期至周四。新增東盟展館，有七個成員國的綠色科技企業參展，包括印尼、老撩、菲律宾、泰國及越南首次參展公司。
展品涵蓋綠色能源、前沿科技、綠色城市及廢物資源化方案。29日為公眾日，免費開放市民入場。
期間將舉辦超過30場論壇及研討會，預期有內地、東盟及一帶一路國家官員及業界代表出席。
